instruction.name: xvfrintrne.s
instruction.description: Round single-precision floating point elements in `a` to integers, rounding towards nearest even, and store as floating point numbers.

experiments.name: dependent vector chain
experiments.notes: Vector registers initialised with normal 1.0/2.0 values, not byte-replicated integers. Measured with unroll=100000.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvfrintrne.s $xr0, $xr8; xvfrintrne.s $xr1, $xr9; xvfrintrne.s $xr2, $xr10; xvfrintrne.s $xr3, $xr11; xvfrintrne.s $xr4, $xr12; xvfrintrne.s $xr5, $xr13; xvfrintrne.s $xr6, $xr14; xvfrintrne.s $xr7, $xr15
throughput.init: li.d $r4, 1065353216; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr15, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --init 'li.d $r4, 1065353216; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr15, $r4' --asm 'xvfrintrne.s $xr0, $xr8; xvfrintrne.s $xr1, $xr9; xvfrintrne.s $xr2, $xr10; xvfrintrne.s $xr3, $xr11; xvfrintrne.s $xr4, $xr12; xvfrintrne.s $xr5, $xr13; xvfrintrne.s $xr6, $xr14; xvfrintrne.s $xr7, $xr15'
throughput.notes: 8 independent instructions take 3.99 cycles. Sources are normal float values. The measured CPI 0.4988 is the nominal 0.5 within measurement noise; the value is reported as the nominal figure.

notes: LASX vector floating-point instruction. Measured on LA664 with normal float operands; latency uses a dependent chain (unroll=100000), throughput uses 8 independent lanes (unroll=1000).
